behaviorVectors.contract: The selected page has higher priority than four forward-only adjacent requests in the serial HTTP queue.

Pager and webtoon request the next chapter through ReaderActivity and ReaderViewModel when fewer than five pages remain; ReaderViewModel calls ChapterLoader.loadChapter, which materializes the page list but does not eagerly fetch every image.
A selected non-error page updates last_page_read, and only the chapter's last logical page invokes completion; duplicate chapter-number marking remains a separate preference rule.
ReaderPage retains one stable index while its inherited Page state changes independently.
ReaderViewModel atomically refs the new current/previous/next window before unrefing the old one.

Pager transition UI shows Loading or Error with Retry; Wait and Loaded add no buttons, and the adapter removes a loaded transition for seamless reading. Fixed original has no Continue or Cancel transition action.

ReaderPreloadPlanner generations, cancellation, and stale-result rejection were added by the Fork; fixed original used a priority queue but did not expose this shared generation contract.
Adjacent portrait-page pairing and its Android dual-page adapter are Fork additions; fixed original only split a single wide source page.

Fixed original RETRY forced an image refetch even when ChapterCache reported a hit; the current Fork generation-hardened HttpPageLoader no longer carries that force flag, so RC-02 must restore and test cached-error Retry semantics.

The current Android dual-page viewer reports only DisplayPage.firstPage to ReaderViewModel; RC-05 and RP-03 must report the settled visible logical-page set so a final pair can complete on its actual last page.

trackedUpstreamChanges.summary: Reader timing moved from java.time.Instant to kotlin.time.Clock without changing session, loading, or progress semantics.
source-api moved from commonMain layout to an Android library main source set; the Page state semantics remained unchanged.
The OkHttp network adapter moved to the TachiyomiX 1.6 suspend and cancellation contract; reader materialization must preserve cooperative request cancellation.
Source adapters moved to the TachiyomiX 1.6 suspend API without changing fixed page ordering or page-state semantics.
Encoded image downloads gained resumable range support; the shared executor and platform adapters must not regress resumable materialization.
Resumed HTTP 206 downloads now report progress against the complete image size instead of only the remaining response body.
Reader import optimization did not change the authority behaviors.
ReaderActivity initialization is no longer forced through a non-cancellable call; Android cutover must retain cooperative cancellation.
ReaderActivity and reader-settings lifecycle ownership migrated to AndroidX ViewModel APIs; the main ReaderViewModel core behavior did not change in this commit.
Paged-reader app bars now hide correctly after page changes following chapter-slider use.
Paged reader gained a vertical chapter navigator and height option; this remains presentation behavior.
Upstream reverted the app-scoped coroutine change, restoring ViewModel-owned reader work.
ImageUtil drawable conversion was mechanically updated without changing wide-image or split policy.
Redundant reader constructs were simplified without changing the frozen state or scheduling vectors.
Duration overload adoption did not change reader timeouts or core state semantics.
Reader work temporarily moved to an app-scoped coroutine before being reverted by 80541831.
Long-strip mode gained a vertical chapter navigator; it does not alter the shared loading core.
ChapterCache now requires both its journal entry and encoded image file to exist, preventing a stale journal entry from causing FileNotFoundException; RC-02 and RC-03 adapters must preserve this fix.
